attrs.help: Run, explain and analyse desflow simulations, fit their inputs, and download the examples.
attrs.epilog:
[bold underline]Examples:[/bold underline]

  [dim]# Run a blueprint, sending its records to its sinks[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow run shop.yaml[/bold cyan]


  [dim]# Print the first five events, with no services[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow run shop.yaml --sample 5[/bold cyan]


  [dim]# Find the bottleneck before running[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow explain shop.yaml[/bold cyan]


  [dim]# List the examples, then download one[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow examples list[/bold cyan]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow examples get local[/bold cyan]

attrs.name: version
attrs.help: Print the installed version and exit.

attrs.name: run
attrs.help: Build the simulation in FILE and run it, or run replications of it.
attrs.epilog:
[bold underline]Examples:[/bold underline]

  [dim]# Run a blueprint, sending its records to its sinks[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow run shop.yaml[/bold cyan]


  [dim]# Print the first five events, with no services[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow run shop.yaml --sample 5[/bold cyan]


  [dim]# Print every record as a JSON line instead of sending it[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow run shop.yaml --stdout[/bold cyan]


  [dim]# Run 20 replications and print the mean and interval of each statistic[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow run shop.yaml --replications 20 --seed 7[/bold cyan]


  [dim]# Fill ${PACKERS} in the file, and run again whenever the file changes[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow run shop.yaml --var PACKERS=3 --sample 5 --watch[/bold cyan]

attrs.name: until
attrs.help: Simulation time to stop at, in seconds or as a duration such as '10 min'. Overrides run.until in the file.

attrs.name: seed
attrs.help: The random seed. Overrides simulation.random_seed in the file. A run without one logs the seed it drew, with the command that repeats it.

attrs.name: drain
attrs.help: At the end time, stop the arrivals and keep running until every entity in the model has left. Sets run.drain in the file to true.

attrs.name: replications
attrs.help: Run N replications unpaced, with seeds spawned from the seed, and print the mean and confidence interval of each statistic.

attrs.name: level
attrs.help: The confidence level of the replications' intervals, between 0 and 1.

attrs.name: measure
attrs.help: A statistic to summarise, such as tasks.pack.wait_mean; repeat it for more. Defaults to every statistic the run publishes, at least up to typical.

attrs.name: workers
attrs.help: Replications run at once, each in its own process.

attrs.name: sample
attrs.help: Print the first N events as JSON lines, unpaced, with no ingress and no real sinks.

attrs.name: stdout
attrs.help: Print every record except the system.simulation.lag_seconds readings as a JSON line, instead of writing to the file's sinks. The lag readings describe the wall clock, not the model.

attrs.name: var
attrs.help: Fill ${NAME} in the file and in the files it includes, before the environment does. Repeat it for more.

attrs.name: watch
attrs.help: Run in a child process, and run again whenever the file or a .py file beside it changes. Needs the watch extra.

attrs.name: check
attrs.help:
Check that each blueprint in FILE... builds, without running it.

It reports what `desflow run` reports before the clock starts: YAML errors,
unknown keys, missing names, unset variables, `!python` references that cannot be
imported, and connectors whose extra is missing or whose settings are refused. It
also reports a Parquet or Jsonl entry when PyArrow is not installed. It does not
call `run.before`, contact a broker, a database or a catalog, or run a `!python`
function. Importing a `!python` module runs its top-level code, as `desflow run`
does. Prints `ok FILE (sim_id ID)` for each valid file and every error of an
invalid one, and exits 1 if any file is invalid.
attrs.epilog:
[bold underline]Examples:[/bold underline]

  [dim]# Check one blueprint without running it[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow check shop.yaml[/bold cyan]


  [dim]# Check every blueprint in a folder, as a pre-commit hook does[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow check examples/*.yaml[/bold cyan]

attrs.name: var
attrs.help: Fill ${NAME} in the files and in the files they include, before the environment does. Repeat it for more.

attrs.name: test
attrs.help:
Run the tests of each file in FILE... and report the statistics that differ.

A test names a seed, an end time and the statistics its run must give, such as
tasks.pack_order.finished. It runs the model once, unpaced, with no ingress and no
egress, so a test contacts no service. A test states its measures at one seed in
one version of desflow: a new release may draw its random numbers differently, so
exact seeded values are not promised across versions. Run it with --fix after an
upgrade or a deliberate change and read the changes. A builder file reads its
tests from a tests.yaml in its folder.

Prints ok for each passing test, and each difference of a failing one. Exits 1 if
any test fails.
attrs.epilog:
[bold underline]Examples:[/bold underline]

  [dim]# Check the tests in a blueprint[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow test shop.yaml[/bold cyan]


  [dim]# Write the statistics the runs gave into the expect values, then read them[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow test shop.yaml --fix[/bold cyan]

attrs.name: fix
attrs.help: Write the statistics the runs gave into the expect values that differ, and into a test with none, instead of reporting differences. Read the changes before you keep them.

attrs.name: var
attrs.help: Fill ${NAME} in a blueprint and in the files it includes, before the environment does. Repeat it for more.

attrs.name: explain
attrs.help: Show the model in SOURCE as a graph, with its utilisation, status, waits and tuning hints where the queueing formulas apply, and why where they do not.
attrs.epilog:
[bold underline]Examples:[/bold underline]

  [dim]# Show the graph, the utilisation and the bottleneck[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow explain shop.yaml[/bold cyan]


  [dim]# Size each resource for a utilisation of 0.7[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow explain shop.yaml --target 0.7[/bold cyan]


  [dim]# Compare the formulas with 10 replications of the model[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow explain shop.yaml --verify --replications 10[/bold cyan]


  [dim]# Print the result as JSON[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow explain shop.yaml --json[/bold cyan]

attrs.name: as_json
attrs.help: Print the explanation as JSON (schema_version 0, experimental).

attrs.name: verify
attrs.help: Also run the model unpaced and compare its statistics with the analysis.

attrs.name: until
attrs.help: With --verify: the end of the run, in seconds or as a duration such as '10 min'. Overrides run.until in the file.

attrs.name: seed
attrs.help: With --verify: the run's seed. Overrides the model's own.

attrs.name: replications
attrs.help: With --verify: run N times and compare with each measure's 95% interval, instead of one run within 10 percent.

attrs.name: target
attrs.help: The utilisation the hints aim for, above 0 and at most 10; at 1 or above the hints are for deliberate overload.

attrs.name: experiment
attrs.help:
Run the experiment in FILE and write its artifacts and report.

Exits 1 if a check fails.
attrs.epilog:
[bold underline]Examples:[/bold underline]

  [dim]# Run an experiment and write its results to a folder[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow experiment experiment.yaml --output results[/bold cyan]

attrs.name: output
attrs.help: Where to write the artifacts. Overrides output in the file.

attrs.name: report
attrs.help: Build the report of an experiment again from the artifacts in FOLDER.
attrs.epilog:
[bold underline]Examples:[/bold underline]

  [dim]# Build the report again from an experiment's results[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow report results[/bold cyan]

attrs.name: fit
attrs.help: Fit a column of FILE to the distribution families, and exit 1 if none is usable.
attrs.epilog:
[bold underline]Examples:[/bold underline]

  [dim]# Fit measured packing times, in seconds[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow fit times.csv --column packing_seconds[/bold cyan]


  [dim]# Write the best fit's settings for a blueprint to load[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow fit times.csv --column packing_seconds --lower 0 --out packing.yaml[/bold cyan]

attrs.name: column
attrs.help: The column to fit.

attrs.name: unit
attrs.help: The data's unit: ms, s, min or h. Settings are in seconds.

attrs.name: candidates
attrs.help: The families to try, separated by commas. Defaults to every family.

attrs.name: lower
attrs.help: The lowest plausible value, in the data's unit.

attrs.name: upper
attrs.help: The highest plausible value, in the data's unit.

attrs.name: bins
attrs.help: Offer the empirical distribution as a histogram with this many bins.

attrs.name: min_count
attrs.help: The fewest values a family is fitted to.

attrs.name: tolerance
attrs.help: How far a fitted mean and standard deviation may be from the data's, as a share of the data's.

attrs.name: drop_invalid
attrs.help: Leave out invalid values rather than stopping.

attrs.name: out
attrs.help: Write the best candidate's settings here, for !include in a blueprint.

attrs.name: plot
attrs.help: Draw the data against the best candidate, as a PNG.

attrs.name: dist
attrs.help:
List the distribution families, or convert parameters to a mean and std and back.

Exits 1 for a family with no formula from a mean and std.
attrs.epilog:
[bold underline]Examples:[/bold underline]

  [dim]# List the distribution families[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow dist[/bold cyan]


  [dim]# Show the parameters and rules of one family[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow dist gamma[/bold cyan]


  [dim]# Convert a mean and standard deviation to gamma parameters[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow dist gamma --mean 1.5 --std 0.4832[/bold cyan]

attrs.name: rate
attrs.help: Events per second.

attrs.name: mean
attrs.help: The mean, a parameter or, with --std, the mean to convert from.

attrs.name: std
attrs.help: The std, a parameter or, with --mean, the std to convert from.

attrs.name: low
attrs.help: The lowest value.

attrs.name: value
attrs.help: A constant's time.

attrs.name: high
attrs.help: The highest value.

attrs.name: mode
attrs.help: The most likely value.

attrs.name: shape
attrs.help: The shape.

attrs.name: scale
attrs.help: The scale.

attrs.name: p
attrs.help: The chance of success on each try.

attrs.name: schema
attrs.help: Print the blueprint JSON Schema.
attrs.epilog:
[bold underline]Examples:[/bold underline]

  [dim]# Save the blueprint schema for an editor[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow schema > blueprint.schema.json[/bold cyan]

attrs.name: examples
attrs.help: List the examples, or download one at the version you have installed.
attrs.epilog:
[bold underline]Examples:[/bold underline]

  [dim]# List the examples[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow examples list[/bold cyan]


  [dim]# Download the YAML version of one[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow examples get local --api yaml[/bold cyan]

attrs.name: list
attrs.help: List the examples, with what each shows and what it needs.
attrs.epilog:
[bold underline]Examples:[/bold underline]

  [dim]# List the examples, with what each shows and the service it needs[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow examples list[/bold cyan]

attrs.name: get
attrs.help: Download an example into <dest>/<name>/<api>/, at the installed release.
attrs.epilog:
[bold underline]Examples:[/bold underline]

  [dim]# Download the three versions of an example into ./local/[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow examples get local[/bold cyan]


  [dim]# Download only the YAML version into another folder[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow examples get local --api yaml --dest work[/bold cyan]


  [dim]# Download it from the main branch[/dim]

  $ [bold cyan]desflow examples get local --ref main[/bold cyan]

attrs.name: api
attrs.help: Only this version: yaml, builder or low-level.

attrs.name: dest
attrs.help: The folder to download into.

attrs.name: ref
attrs.help: A git tag or branch. Defaults to the installed release's tag.

attrs.name: force
attrs.help: Replace files that are already there.
